corpus_observations.observation: Film posters favor grain, dim tonal ranges, shallow focus and imperfect occlusion, preserving the feeling of paused documentary footage rather than standalone campaign polish.
Craft is communicated through extreme material proximity and active hands; labels, weave, pores, grain and tool contact carry more attention than full product silhouettes.
Le Journal extends the brand into high-detail black-and-white engraving and surreal product metaphors, distinct from the photographic film language while retaining tactile print associations.
Across global labs, signage remains visually subordinate to local masonry, glass, vegetation, wires and pavement, so city context is not cleaned away.
